name: agrigrow-farm-management
description: 🌾 AgriGrow — AI-powered Farm Management Web App (MERN Stack)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c green,cyan "npm run server" "npm run client"
scripts.dev:full: concurrently -n ml,server,client -c magenta,green,cyan "cd ml-service && python -m uvicorn app:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload" "npm run server" "npm run client"
scripts.install-all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
